source_bindings.role: durable decoded held-out result and paired P0-B1 differences
pre-existing held-out design, pairing, primary metric and material-effect contract

ignored_non_authoritative_local_source.reason: Local ignored result material exists but is not required for the desk study. The tracked durable final result contains the exact paired differences and summary facts used here.

observed_design.independence_rule: The ten paired runs are repeated stochastic samples nested in two benchmark items. They must not be treated as ten independent benchmark items.

analysis_contract.model: d_ir = mu + u_i + e_ir, with independent item effects u_i variance tau^2 and within-item stochastic paired residuals e_ir variance sigma^2.
analysis_contract.within_item_variance_estimator: Pool the ordinary sample variances of repeated paired differences within H1 and H2 using within-item degrees of freedom.
analysis_contract.power_method: Two-sided large-sample normal planning approximation for the mean paired item effect.
analysis_contract.normal_quantile_rule: z_(1-alpha/2) + z_(power), computed with Python statistics.NormalDist.

between_item_sensitivity.basis: The current two-item corpus cannot identify between-item heterogeneity reliably. Report method-of-moments information descriptively, but power planning must use tau sensitivity ratios rather than treating tau_hat=0 as truth.

analysis_contract.future_campaign_primary_analysis: Pair candidate and baseline within each independent item and stochastic replicate. Aggregate or model repeats within item; inference/generalization is item-clustered, with J independent item clusters as the sample-size axis.
analysis_contract.multiplicity: One decisive metric only for this desk study: targeted_architecture_score. Other outcomes may remain diagnostics and must not silently create multiple decisive tests.

negative_control.name: PSEUDO_INDEPENDENT_REPEATS
negative_control.procedure: Compute the naive standard error obtained by treating all ten paired repeats as independent items, then compare it with the cluster-aware current-study standard error under tau = 2*sigma. The naive value must not be used for decision-grade sample-size recommendations and the cluster-aware sensitivity standard error must be larger.
negative_control.purpose: Prove the desk study does not invent independence from repeated samples.

public_private_release_contract.rule: All repeats for one item stay in one partition. Public/development items may support variance estimation, harness/judge calibration and preregistration. Private held-out items remain untouched until the confirmatory campaign and provide the release/BLOCK evidence.
public_private_release_contract.anti_leakage: Do not split stochastic repeats of the same item across public and private partitions.

requirements: The preserved evidence yields a finite positive within-item paired stochastic variance estimate from the two repeated item clusters.
The analysis explicitly distinguishes J=2 independent items from 10 repeated paired runs and never uses the naive n=10 independence assumption for the recommendation.
Finite required independent-item counts are produced for every preregistered MDE/repeat/tau-sensitivity combination.

Under the conservative tau=2*sigma sensitivity, at least one design with R in {2,3,5} supports MDE <= 0.10 at alpha=0.05 and power=0.80 within no more than 200 total candidate+baseline treatment executions.
The campaign design is paired by candidate/baseline item and item-clustered when repeats exist.
A public-development versus private-held-out confirmatory split is required at item level for decision-grade BLOCK claims.
Current Prototype V0 evidence is not upgraded into a decision-grade generalization claim merely because it supplies variance-planning evidence.
probe_pass_criteria.inconclusive_if: The preserved evidence cannot support the variance calculation or no preregistered finite campaign satisfies the bounded feasibility discriminator.
probe_pass_criteria.amend_if: The calculations show that WARRANT-F V0.2 requires a materially different stochastic decision model rather than only a larger/preregistered campaign.

interpretation_limits: The two observed benchmark items are insufficient to estimate population-level between-item heterogeneity reliably.
The normal approximation is a desk-study planning calculation, not the final confirmatory analysis method.
The historical observed +0.05 P0-B1 difference is descriptive and is not promoted into a post-hoc target effect.
No live model call is permitted in P-S.
